comment: Library after D-library-1: every floor part of the four quarters repeats row 3 (the top window and bookshelf row), so the window bands stay level across chunks. Positions are offsets from `locate library00`, which gives the center (local 8, 8) of the north-west quarter at the city ground. Local x 0-31 runs east over library00/10, local z 0-31 south over library00/01. library00_1's stair is at local x 13-14, climbing south from z 7 (y 1) through the ceiling to the floor above (slab y 8 at pitch 8).
title: Library: level window bands, unbroken stair
